title: Measuring and enhancing participation of children with chronic conditions and disabilities – Psychometric evaluation of the Participation and Environment Measure for Children and Youth and application in collaborative care planning for children with chronic conditions and disabilities
summary: This study investigates how the participation of children and adolescents with chronic conditions and disabilities can be better assessed and supported. To do this, a questionnaire (Participation and Environment Measure for Children and Youth, PEM-CY) in German is first reviewed. In the next step, the questionnaire is used to improve counseling at the social pediatrics center of the Children's and Youth Hospital Freiburg. The goal is to develop specific participation goals for the children together with the families. The study also examines how well the questionnaire can be used in everyday practice and how it is received by families and professionals.
conditions: Chronic conditions and disabilities in children and adolescents

interventions.name:
Name: Online Survey (Psychometric Evaluation)
Type: Cross-sectional study
Description: Parents of children aged 5-17 years (with and without chronic conditions) complete an online questionnaire (PEM-CY, German version) to evaluate participation. Data is collected anonymously via the RedCap platfor

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Sufficient knowledge of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
No sufficient knowledge of the German language
